title: Live Full List with the pinned music banner: a focused row is never hidden under it, and short phones keep a row in view
acceptance: In Live › Full List with the Waiting for music or Playback stopped panel pinned, a keyboard-focused or programmatically scrolled row lands fully below the panel (WCAG 2.2 focus not obscured).
At 390x480 with a failure showing, at least one Full List row is fully visible between the panel and the bottom dock, or the owner accepts that it is not.
The e2e smoke shows the Waiting for music banner in Full List, so CI screenshots cover the pinned layout.
The reveal doc comment in LiveMode.tsx describes what Full List does.
nextAction: Non-blocking findings from the #766 final review, measured afterwards in Chromium at 390 wide (2026-11-13). Likely fix: add the panel's height to the Live shell's scroll padding in Full List. LiveMode.tsx is owner-gated. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review on 6e30dd3 (the PR diff is identical on the merged head ed5e94b): no significant findings. Non-blocking: a keyboard-focused or programmatically scrolled Full List row can land under the pinned panel; the new test asserts a class name in jsdom; the reveal doc comment is out of date. The PR comment also records the measurement made after the review: at 390 wide and 844, 667, 568 and 480 tall every panel button stays visible and clickable, and at 390x480 with a failure no row is fully visible. Not measured: Safari, Spotify's activation action inside the panel, other widths.

From the RF-211 agent's measurement report to the conducting session (2026-11-13, Chromium, 390 wide, built SPA with mock providers; not posted on the PR): walking focus up the list from row 15 left 12 to 14 of 15 rows overlapping the pinned panel, most of them fully hidden in the failure states; with the sticky class removed, none did.
